citrus-cartel-makhana.name: Bhel
citrus-cartel-makhana.ingredients: 1 cup puffed rice, 1/2 onion chopped, 1 tomato chopped, coriander leaves, 1/4 cup Korigo Chilli Lime Makhana.
citrus-cartel-makhana.instructions: Combine puffed rice, onion and tomato in a bowl, mix well and top with Korigo Chilli Lime Makhana and coriander before serving

citrus-cartel-makhana.name: Pani Puri Filling Bowl
citrus-cartel-makhana.ingredients: 1 boiled potato chopped, 1/4 cup boiled chana, onion and coriander, 1/4 cup Korigo Chilli Lime Makhana.
citrus-cartel-makhana.instructions: Mix potato, chana, onion and coriander in a bowl and add Korigo Chilli Lime Makhana for crunch before serving.

citrus-cartel-makhana.name: Citrus Salad
citrus-cartel-makhana.ingredients: 1 cucumber chopped, 1 avocado sliced, lime juice, onion slices, 1/4 cup Korigo Chilli Lime Makhana.
citrus-cartel-makhana.instructions: Combine cucumber, avocado and onion in a bowl, drizzle lime juice and gently mix. Top with Korigo Chilli Lime Makhana.

coco-world-makhana.name: Banana / Berry Smoothie Bowl
coco-world-makhana.ingredients: 1 banana or 1 cup mixed berries, 1/2 cup yogurt or milk, 1/4 cup granola (optional), 1/4 cup Korigo Chocolate Makhana, coconut flakes or almonds
coco-world-makhana.instructions: Blend banana or berries with yogurt or milk to make a smoothie base. Pour into a bowl and add granola, coconut flakes or almonds and Korigo Chocolate Makhana on top. Serve immediately.

coco-world-makhana.name: Healthy Trail Mix
coco-world-makhana.ingredients: 1/4 cup almonds, 1/4 cup cashews, 1/4 cup raisins, 1/2 cup Korigo Chocolate Makhana.
coco-world-makhana.instructions: Combine almonds, cashews, raisins and Korigo Chocolate Makhana in a bowl. Mix well and store in an airtight container for a quick energy boosting snack.

coco-world-makhana.name: Chia Pudding Bowl
coco-world-makhana.ingredients: 2 tbsp chia seeds, 1 cup milk, 1 tsp honey or maple syrup, 1/4 cup Korigo Chocolate Makhana.
coco-world-makhana.instructions: Soak chia seeds in milk overnight until thick. Add honey or maple syrup and top with Korigo Chocolate Makhana before serving

creme-d-onion-makhana.name: Savory Oats Bowl
creme-d-onion-makhana.ingredients: 1/2 cup oats, 1 cup water or milk, mixed vegetables, 1/4 cup Korigo Cream & Onion Makhana.
creme-d-onion-makhana.instructions: Cook oats with water or milk and add vegetables while cooking. Transfer to a bowl and top with Korigo Cream & Onion Makhana.

creme-d-onion-makhana.name: Yogurt Dip Bowl
creme-d-onion-makhana.ingredients: 1 cup Greek yogurt, 1/2 cucumber chopped, fresh herbs, 1/4 cup Korigo Cream & Onion Makhana.
creme-d-onion-makhana.instructions: Mix Greek yogurt with cucumber and herbs in a bowl and sprinkle Korigo Cream & Onion Makhana on top before serving.

creme-d-onion-makhana.name: Stuffed Sandwich
creme-d-onion-makhana.ingredients: 2 slices whole wheat bread, hummus or mashed avocado, fresh vegetables, 1/4 cup Korigo Cream & Onion Makhana.
creme-d-onion-makhana.instructions: Spread hummus or avocado on bread, add vegetables and Korigo Cream & Onion Makhana, then close the sandwich and serve.

garlicked-cheese-makhana.name: Avocado Toast
garlicked-cheese-makhana.ingredients: 1 slice whole grain bread, 1/2 avocado mashed, salt and pepper, 1/4 cup Korigo Garlic Cheese Makhana.
garlicked-cheese-makhana.instructions: Toast the bread and spread mashed avocado on top. Season with salt and pepper and sprinkle Korigo Garlic Cheese Makhana for a crunchy topping.

garlicked-cheese-makhana.name: Buddha Bowl
garlicked-cheese-makhana.ingredients: 1/2 cup quinoa or brown rice, 1/2 cup roasted vegetables, 1/4 cup chickpeas, 1/4 cup Korigo Garlic Cheese Makhana.
garlicked-cheese-makhana.instructions: Place quinoa or rice in a bowl and add roasted vegetables and chickpeas. Finish by sprinkling Korigo Garlic Cheese Makhana for added flavor and texture.

garlicked-cheese-makhana.name: Creamy Soup Topping
garlicked-cheese-makhana.ingredients: 1 bowl tomato, mushroom or pumpkin soup, 1/4 cup Korigo Garlic Cheese Makhana.
garlicked-cheese-makhana.instructions: Prepare your soup and pour it into a bowl. Add Korigo Garlic Cheese Makhana on top just before serving to create a crunchy topping.

cinnamon-drip.name: Apple Cinnamon Toast
cinnamon-drip.ingredients: 1 slice whole grain bread, peanut or almond butter, apple slices, 1/4 cup Korigo Cinnamon Honey Makhana.
cinnamon-drip.instructions: Toast bread and spread peanut or almond butter on top. Add apple slices and sprinkle Korigo Cinnamon Honey Makhana

cinnamon-drip.name: Ricotta Honey Dessert Bowl
cinnamon-drip.ingredients: 1/2 cup ricotta cheese, 1 tsp honey, 1/4 cup Korigo Cinnamon Honey Makhana
cinnamon-drip.instructions: Add ricotta to a bowl, drizzle honey and top with Korigo Cinnamon Honey Makhana for a creamy dessert

cinnamon-drip.name: Frozen Yogurt Bark
cinnamon-drip.ingredients: 1 cup Greek yogurt, mixed fruits, 1/4 cup Korigo Cinnamon Honey Makhana
cinnamon-drip.instructions: Spread yogurt on a tray, add fruits and Korigo Cinnamon Honey Makhana and freeze until solid. Break into pieces before serving

sassy-sriracha.name: Spicy Wrap
sassy-sriracha.ingredients: 1 whole wheat tortilla, lettuce leaves, grilled vegetables, 1/4 cup Korigo Sweet Sriracha Makhana.
sassy-sriracha.instructions: Place lettuce and grilled vegetables on the tortilla, add Korigo Sweet Sriracha Makhana, roll the wrap tightly and slice before serving.

sassy-sriracha.name: Asian Salad
sassy-sriracha.ingredients: 1 cup shredded cabbage, 1/2 cup carrot, 1/2 cup cucumber, sesame dressing, 1/4 cup Korigo Sweet Sriracha Makhana.
sassy-sriracha.instructions: Mix cabbage, carrot and cucumber in a bowl and toss with sesame dressing. Top with Korigo Sweet Sriracha Makhana for extra crunch.

sassy-sriracha.name: Rice Paper Rolls
sassy-sriracha.ingredients: Rice paper sheets, mixed vegetables, fresh herbs, 1/4 cup Korigo Sweet Sriracha Makhana.
sassy-sriracha.instructions: Soften rice paper in warm water, add vegetables, herbs and Korigo Sweet Sriracha Makhana, then roll tightly and serve with dipping sauce
